Chapter 12. Domestic Relations

§ 12.360 Parenting coordinators.

(1) In a high-conflict matter the court may appoint a parenting coordinator to resolve day-to-day disputes about the parenting schedule.

Enacted by 2026 Exampleland Act 31. This section takes effect on January 1, 2027.
